_: Commanding the King's hosts (realm/scripts/host_command.gd; Warcraft III's fixed command card and ground ring, Total War's banner that glows when selected and its route on the campaign map). on: the switch (or --hosts=on / --hosts=off). A click selects the host whose standard-bearer or regiment it meets (host_pick.gd: a physics ray at the press, no screen-distance guess). ring: the ground ring under a selected host, in the crown's house colour (radius in world units, plus so much per company, up to max; never under screen x the lens's distance, so it reads at play zoom; colour when no crown is known). glow: the light on a selected host's banner. route: the dotted line to where a host is ordered (dot size and spacing in world units; colour, and alpha for a host not selected; end_ring the ring where it is bound, never under end_screen x the lens's distance, in its order's colour; pending_s: an order just given is drawn at once to where the King pointed, for so many seconds or until /world shows it). town_reach: an order given this near a town's centre, in world units (a tile is 4), goes to the town rather than to the ground. orders: the command card, left to right (READY.md line 8: march, attack, besiege, hold, go home; research section 1 point 8), each with its icon (realm/assets/icons, Phosphor) and words on hover, aim: true for an order that waits for the King to click where (the ground, a town, a foe), and send: the bridge's order it is when that is another's name (Besiege is the bridge's own besiege order (4cbad5ff: a great house's town not sworn to the crown, siege laid at the walls), relieve its march into a town of the crown's or a sworn house's); its hotkey is the Input Map action host_<order> (keys.gd, changeable in Settings). doing: what the card says the host is doing, by its order's kind ({to} where it is bound, {road} how many seasons away; there: once it has arrived). face (Total War's drag to face, research point 7): with a host selected, a right-drag longer than drag_px on screen draws the line the host will form on, a ghost mark per company (ghost: size and colour), and on release marches it there facing away from the line as dragged (left to right faces up the screen).

orders.tip: March: then click where on the map, or a town (right-click also marches; right-drag to set the line it forms on)
Attack: then click a foe's host to fall on it
Besiege: then click a foe's town to lay siege to it and take it
Garrison: then click a town of yours or of a house sworn to you
Go home: march home to the King's seat
Split: half its companies stand apart as a host of their own

_troops: troops: how a host's strength reads on its card ({men} the count; Mac: troops, not men).

cursor._: While an order waits for the King to click where (host_command.gd _cursor; Warcraft III's order cursor): the pointer is that order's card icon, size px square, filled in the accent (red for an attack or a siege) on a dark rim this many px wide; its hotspot at the middle.

marker._: Where an order lands, a ring flashed on the ground (Warcraft III's command marker): from and to, its width at the start and end in world units (from never under screen x the lens's distance, to kept in proportion), secs how long it takes to close and fade, energy its glow; colors by order (WC3: green to move, red to attack), color for any other.

result._: The King's battle when it is over (battle_card.gd; CK3's battle summary; bridge battles.js): told once, bottom-left over the ticker (above: px up from the screen's foot), for show_s seconds or until clicked. head_won / head_lost: its head ({place}: 'at Redmarch', 'near Redmarch', 'in the open field'); victor: after the side that won; men / lost: each side's men and its losses; fell: the King's captains who fell there ({names}, each as captain).
result._reward: reward: what the King won, each field of the battle card's reward (bridge battles.js) and its words ({n} the amount, or the name for a town).

left._: The card's line on the selected host's orders this season (bridge hosts.json ordersPerHost, /world hosts[].ordersLeft): one, with one left; some, with {n} the orders left; none, when spent; why, the greyed buttons' tip.
left.none: The captains have their orders this season
left.why: The captains have their orders this season. The next goes with the turn of the season.

card._: The selected host's makeup line on its card (host_command.gd _makeup; Warcraft III's unit panel): kinds, the word for each Freeciv unit type (a type not named shows as itself); morale, [at least, word] from highest, read against /world hosts[].morale (0..1), (bridge ad5b638a: health x supply).

_group: group: the card's title while several hosts are selected (shift- or Cmd-click, a Cmd-drag box, a double-click on a standard, F2); {n} how many. The card then counts all their troops and companies.
_pick: pick_px: a left click takes the King's standard nearest it within so many pixels when the click misses every body (host_pick.gd near; a standard is a few pixels across at play zoom). foe_px: the same for a right-click (or Attack's click) on a foe's men.

box._: The selection box (Cmd-drag on the land, Shift-drag adds; StarCraft's, Warcraft III's): drag_px how far the pointer goes before a press is a box, not a click; grow_px how far round the box a standard still counts; the box a white line (line px, alpha) on a dark outline (outline px, outline_alpha).

hover._: What a right-click would do where the pointer is, while a host is selected (host_command.gd _hover_read; Warcraft III's cursor over a foe): word, the one word by the pointer; line, the card's line ({who}: the foe's men, the town); aim_line, the same while an order from the card waits for its click (Attack on open ground marches there); foe / raiders, whose men in that line ({house}); idle, the card's line before the pointer has been over the land.
hover.idle: Right-click the land to march, a foe to attack
